learn.b: Say Olá for hello. Use Bom dia in the morning, Boa tarde in the afternoon and Boa noite in the evening or at night. To say goodbye, use Tchau.
Say Meu nome é and your name: Meu nome é Ana means My name is Ana. Ask Tudo bem? to say How are you? or Is everything good? and answer Tudo bem.
Men say obrigado and women say obrigada for thank you. De nada means you're welcome. Por favor means please.

qs.q: How do you say 'good morning' in Portuguese?
qs.why: Bom dia is used to greet people in the morning.

qs.q: What does 'Meu nome é Ana' mean?
qs.why: Meu nome é means 'my name is'.

qs.q: A woman wants to say 'thank you'. Which word does she use?
qs.why: Women say obrigada and men say obrigado.

qs.q: What does 'Tudo bem?' ask?
o: How are you? / Is everything good?
qs.why: Tudo bem? is a common way to ask how someone is.

qs.q: 'Tchau' means 'goodbye'.
qs.why: Tchau is a common way to say goodbye.

lab.why: A man says obrigado; a woman says obrigada.

lab.q: Challenge: translate to Portuguese: My name is Lucas.
lab.why: Meu nome é means My name is.

learn.b: Count like this: um, dois, três, quatro, cinco, seis, sete, oito, nove, dez. Use them for ages, prices and phone numbers.
Vermelho is red, azul is blue, verde is green and amarelo is yellow. Colors usually come after the noun: a maçã vermelha means the red apple.
Learn o pão (bread), a água (water), a maçã (apple) and o leite (milk). To ask for something, say Eu quero and then the thing. Eu quero água means I want water.

qs.q: What is 'cinco' in English?
qs.why: Cinco is the number five.

qs.q: Which word means 'green'?
qs.why: Verde means green.

qs.q: What does 'a maçã' mean?
qs.why: A maçã is the apple.

qs.q: How do you say 'I want water'?
qs.why: Eu quero means 'I want'.

qs.q: 'Sete' means seven.
qs.why: Sete is the number seven.

lab.why: Eu quero means I want, and leite is milk.

learn.b: Learn a mãe (mother), o pai (father), o irmão (brother) and a irmã (sister). O goes with masculine words and a with feminine words.
Ser has the forms eu sou (I am) and você é (you are) or ele é (he is). Eu sou estudante means I am a student.
Ter has the forms eu tenho (I have) and você tem (you have) or ela tem (she has). Eu tenho um irmão means I have a brother.

qs.q: What does 'a irmã' mean?
qs.why: A irmã means the sister.

qs.q: Complete: Eu ___ estudante. (I am a student)
qs.why: Sou is the 'I' form of ser (to be).

qs.q: How do you say 'I have a brother'?
qs.why: Tenho is the 'I' form of ter (to have).

qs.q: Complete: Ela ___ dois gatos. (She has two cats)
qs.why: Tem is the 'he or she' form of ter.

qs.q: 'O pai' means 'the father'.
qs.why: O pai is the father.

qs.q: Match each family word to its meaning
Put the words in order: 'I have two brothers'

lab.q: Challenge: translate: the sister.
lab.why: A irmã means the sister.

lab.q: Challenge: fill in the verb ter: Eu ___ um irmão. (I have a brother)
lab.why: Eu tenho is I have.

lab.q: Challenge: translate: I am a student.
lab.why: Eu sou estudante means I am a student.

learn.b: Use o or a for 'the' with one thing and os or as for many. Um and uma mean 'a'. Most plurals add -s: livro becomes livros. Words ending in -l change, like animal to animais.
Monday to Friday end in -feira: segunda-feira, terça-feira, quarta-feira, quinta-feira and sexta-feira. Then come sábado and domingo.
Use Onde fica...? to ask where a place is. Onde fica a escola? means Where is the school? A casa (house) and a escola (school) are both feminine.

qs.q: Which article goes with 'casa' (house)?
qs.why: Casa is feminine, so it uses a.

qs.q: What is the plural of 'livro'?
qs.why: Add -s to words that end in a vowel: livros.

qs.q: What does 'quarta-feira' mean?
qs.why: Quarta-feira is Wednesday, the fourth day in the Portuguese count.

qs.q: What does 'Onde fica a escola?' ask?
qs.why: Onde means 'where'.

qs.q: 'Sábado' means Sunday.
qs.why: Sábado is Saturday; Sunday is domingo.

Put these days in order, starting from Monday

lab.why: Most plurals add -s: livros.

lab.hint: It is the fourth day counting from domingo.
lab.why: Quarta-feira is Wednesday.

lab.q: Challenge: translate: Where is the school?
lab.why: Onde fica a escola? asks where the school is.

learn.b: Put the question word first. Quem is who, O que is what, Onde is where, Quando is when, Como is how, Por que is why and Quanto is how much. Onde você mora? means Where do you live?
Ask De onde você é? to say Where are you from? Answer Eu sou da Itália (I am from Italy) or Eu sou do Brasil. With a city, use de: Eu sou de Roma.
Say brasileiro or brasileira, italiano or italiana, americano or americana. The ending changes for a woman. Eu moro em Roma means I live in Rome.

qs.q: How do you ask 'Where are you from?'
qs.why: De onde você é? is the standard question.

qs.q: What does 'Por que' mean in a question?
qs.why: Por que means why.

qs.q: Complete: Eu moro ___ Roma. (I live in Rome)
qs.why: Em means in, so Eu moro em Roma.

qs.q: A woman from Italy says: Eu sou ___.
qs.why: A woman uses the feminine ending -a.

qs.q: 'Quando' means 'where'.
qs.why: Quando means when; onde means where.

Put the words in order: 'Where are you from?'

lab.hint: Onde is where; morar is to live.
lab.why: Onde você mora? asks where you live.

lab.hint: Use sou do for masculine countries.

lab.why: Quando means when.

learn.b: Falar (to speak) goes eu falo, você fala, nós falamos. Trabalhar, morar and estudar work the same way. Eu falo inglês means I speak English.
Comer (to eat) goes eu como, você come, nós comemos. Beber (to drink) goes eu bebo. Abrir (to open) goes eu abro, você abre, nós abrimos.
Put não before the verb: Eu não falo russo. To ask a question, raise your voice: Você fala inglês? You can answer Sim, falo.

qs.q: Complete: Eu ___ inglês. (I speak English)
qs.why: Eu goes with the -o form: falo.

qs.q: What does 'nós comemos' mean?
qs.why: Nós is we and comemos is the nós form of comer.

qs.q: How do you say 'I don't speak Russian'?
qs.why: Não goes right before the verb.

qs.q: Complete: Ela ___ água. (She drinks water)
qs.why: Ela goes with the -e form: bebe.

qs.q: 'Estudar' is an -er verb.
qs.why: Estudar ends in -ar, so it is an -ar verb.

lab.why: Eu trabalho means I work.

lab.q: Challenge: translate: We eat bread.
lab.why: Nós comemos pão means We eat bread.

lab.q: Challenge: translate: She drinks milk.
lab.why: Ela bebe leite means She drinks milk.

learn.b: Ask Que horas são? for What time is it? Say São duas horas for It is two o'clock. For one o'clock, say É uma hora. Meio-dia is noon and meia-noite is midnight.
Learn janeiro, fevereiro, março, abril, maio, junho, julho, agosto, setembro, outubro, novembro and dezembro. Months are not written with capital letters in Portuguese.
Hoje is today and amanhã is tomorrow. Eu acordo às sete means I wake up at seven. The seasons are verão (summer), outono (autumn), inverno (winter) and primavera (spring).

qs.q: How do you say 'It is two o'clock'?
qs.why: For two or more hours use São and the feminine duas.

qs.q: What does 'meio-dia' mean?
qs.why: Meio-dia is half-day, so noon.

qs.q: Which month is 'março'?
qs.why: Março is March; maio is May.

qs.q: What does 'inverno' mean?
qs.why: Inverno is winter.

qs.q: 'Amanhã' means 'yesterday'.
qs.why: Amanhã is tomorrow; ontem is yesterday.

lab.why: Que horas são? asks the time.

lab.q: Challenge: type the Portuguese word for 'summer'.
lab.why: Verão is summer.

lab.q: Challenge: translate: It is one o'clock.
lab.why: É uma hora is the form for one o'clock.

learn.b: Learn a sala (living room), a cozinha (kitchen), o banheiro (bathroom) and o quarto (bedroom). A casa is a house and o apartamento is an apartment.
Learn o banco (bank), o mercado (market), a farmácia (pharmacy), o parque (park) and a rua (street). Em + o becomes no and em + a becomes na: Eu estou no parque means I am in the park.
Use estar for where you are: Eu estou na cozinha. Use ir + a for where you go: Eu vou ao banco means I go to the bank. Ao is a + o.

qs.q: What is 'a cozinha'?
qs.why: A cozinha is the kitchen.

qs.q: Complete: Eu estou ___ parque. (in the park)
qs.why: Parque is masculine, so em + o = no.

qs.q: What does 'a farmácia' mean?
qs.why: A farmácia is the pharmacy.

qs.q: How do you say 'I am going to the bank'?
qs.why: Ir + a + o gives vou ao.

qs.q: 'O quarto' can mean 'the bedroom'.
qs.why: O quarto is the bedroom, and also a room in a hotel.

lab.why: A cozinha is the kitchen.

lab.q: Challenge: fill in one word: Eu estou ___ cozinha. (in the)
lab.why: Em + a becomes na.

lab.q: Challenge: translate: I am going to the market.
lab.why: Eu vou ao mercado means I am going to the market.

learn.b: Alto (tall), baixo (short), bonito (pretty) and simpático (nice) change for a woman: alta, baixa, bonita, simpática. Ele é alto, ela é alta. For many, add -s: eles são altos.

Use ser for lasting traits: Ela é simpática. Use estar for feelings and states: Eu estou cansado (tired), feliz (happy), triste (sad). Estou com fome means I am hungry and estou com sede means I am thirsty.
Ask Como ele é? for What is he like? Ask Como você está? for How are you feeling now? Use muito for very. For age, use ter: Eu tenho dezesseis anos means I am sixteen.

qs.q: Complete: Maria é ___. (Maria is tall)
qs.why: Maria is a woman, so use the feminine alta.

qs.q: Complete: Eu ___ cansado. (I am tired right now)
qs.why: Feelings use estar: estou.

qs.q: What does 'Estou com fome' mean?
qs.why: Fome is hunger.

qs.q: How do you say 'I am fifteen years old'?
qs.why: Portuguese uses ter for age.

qs.q: 'Triste' means 'happy'.
qs.why: Triste means sad; feliz means happy.

Put the words in order: 'She is very nice'

lab.q: Challenge: translate: He is tall.
lab.why: Ele é alto means He is tall.

lab.q: Challenge: translate: I am hungry.
lab.why: Estou com fome means I am hungry.

learn.b: Learn a camisa (shirt), a calça (pants), o vestido (dress), o sapato (shoe) and o casaco (coat). Ask Quanto custa? for How much is it? Answer Custa vinte reais.

Brazil's money is the real, plural reais. Say Quero comprar uma camisa for I want to buy a shirt. Está caro means it is expensive and está barato means it is cheap. Learn onze (11), doze (12), quinze (15), vinte (20) and trinta (30).
Say Faz sol (it is sunny), Faz calor (it is hot) and Faz frio (it is cold). Está chovendo means it is raining and está nublado means it is cloudy.

qs.q: What does 'Quanto custa?' mean?
qs.why: Quanto custa? asks the price.

qs.q: What is 'o casaco'?
qs.why: O casaco is the coat.

qs.q: How do you say 'It is cold'?
qs.why: Faz frio means it is cold.

qs.q: What does 'barato' mean?
qs.why: Barato is cheap; caro is expensive.

qs.q: 'Vinte' means twenty.
qs.why: Vinte is 20.

Put the words in order: 'I want to buy a shirt'

lab.why: Quanto custa? asks the price.

lab.why: Faz calor means it is hot.

lab.q: Challenge: type the Portuguese word for 'dress'.
lab.why: O vestido is the dress.

learn.b: For -ar verbs, use -ei, -ou, -amos: falei (I spoke), falou (he or she spoke). For -er verbs, use -i, -eu, -emos: comi (I ate), comeu (he or she ate).

learn.h: Ir and ser in the past
learn.b: Ir (to go) and ser (to be) share the same past forms: fui, foi, fomos. Context tells you which one is meant. Fui ao cinema means I went to the cinema.
Use ontem (yesterday), ontem à noite (last night), semana passada (last week) and ano passado (last year). They show that the action is finished.

qs.q: Complete: Ontem eu ___ pizza. (I ate)
qs.why: Comi is the past 'I' form of comer.

qs.q: What does 'Falei com ela' mean?
qs.why: Falei is the past 'I' form of falar.

I go to the cinema every day
I will go to the cinema tomorrow
qs.why: Fui is 'I went' and ontem is 'yesterday'.

qs.why: Ontem means yesterday.

qs.q: 'Ele comeu' means 'He ate'.
qs.why: Comeu is the past 'he or she' form of comer.

learn.b: Use à esquerda (to the left), à direita (to the right) and siga em frente (go straight ahead). Na esquina means on the corner.
Perto de means near and longe de means far from. To ask the way, say Como chego à estação? (How do I get to the station?).
Learn o aeroporto (airport), o ônibus (bus), a estação (station) and o quarto (room). Use reservar for to book.

qs.q: What does 'à esquerda' mean?
qs.why: Esquerda means left.

qs.q: What does 'siga em frente' mean?
qs.why: Siga em frente means go straight ahead.

qs.q: How do you ask 'How do I get to the station?'
qs.why: Como chego a...? is the usual way to ask for directions.

qs.q: What is 'o quarto' at a hotel?
qs.why: O quarto means the room.

qs.q: 'Perto de' means 'far from'.
qs.why: Perto de means near; longe de means far from.

lab.why: À esquerda means to the left.

lab.why: Como chego à estação? asks the way to the station.

learn.b: Use eu gosto de (I like) and eu adoro (I love). Eu gosto de música means I like music. Say eu não gosto de for I don't like.
Say eu acho que to mean I think that. Say eu concordo for I agree and eu não concordo for I disagree.
Eu prefiro means I prefer. Porque means because, and mais...do que means more than. O filme é mais longo do que o livro means the film is longer than the book.

qs.q: What does 'Eu gosto de livros' mean?
qs.why: Eu gosto de means 'I like'.

qs.q: What does 'Eu concordo' mean?
qs.why: Concordo means I agree.

qs.q: How do you say 'I think that it is good'?
qs.why: Eu acho que + a sentence means 'I think that...'.

qs.q: What does 'mais ... do que' mean?
qs.why: Mais do que is used to compare: more than.

qs.q: 'Não concordo' means 'I disagree'.
qs.why: Não turns 'I agree' into 'I do not agree'.

lab.why: Eu gosto de música means I like music.

lab.why: Eu prefiro means I prefer.

lab.why: Eu concordo means I agree.

learn.b: Use ir + a verb to talk about plans: eu vou viajar means I am going to travel. Add words like amanhã (tomorrow) or ano que vem (next year).
Reflexive verbs use me: eu me levanto (I get up). Other useful phrases are tomar banho (to shower), tomar café (to have breakfast or coffee) and ir dormir (to go to sleep).
The imperfect tense talks about habits in the past. Eu jogava means I used to play. Use words like sempre (always) and quando eu era criança (when I was a child).

qs.q: Complete: Amanhã eu ___ viajar. (I'm going to travel)
qs.why: Vou + verb expresses a plan for the future.

qs.q: What does 'Eu me levanto às sete' mean?

qs.why: Eu me levanto means 'I get up'.

qs.q: Which form means 'I used to play'?
qs.why: Jogava is the imperfect, used for past habits.

qs.q: What does 'ano que vem' mean?
qs.why: Que vem means 'that is coming', so ano que vem is next year.

qs.q: 'Eu vou dormir' means 'I wake up'.
qs.why: Eu vou dormir means I'm going to sleep.

lab.why: Eu vou viajar means I am going to travel.

lab.why: Eu jogava means I used to play.

lab.why: Ano que vem means next year.

learn.b: Learn a cabeça (head), o braço (arm), a perna (leg), a mão (hand) and o estômago (stomach). Say Estou com dor de cabeça for I have a headache. You can also say Minha cabeça dói.
O médico is the doctor, o remédio is medicine and a febre is fever. Say Estou doente (I am sick), Tenho febre (I have a fever) and Preciso de um médico (I need a doctor).
Doctors say Você deve descansar (You should rest) and Beba muita água (Drink a lot of water). Use há for how long: Estou doente há dois dias means I have been sick for two days.

qs.why: Dor de cabeça is a headache.

qs.q: What is 'o remédio'?
qs.why: O remédio is medicine.

qs.q: How do you say 'I need a doctor'?
qs.why: Precisar de means to need.

qs.q: What does 'Você deve descansar' mean?
qs.why: Deve is should.

qs.q: 'A perna' means 'the arm'.
qs.why: A perna is the leg; o braço is the arm.

lab.why: Tenho febre means I have a fever.

lab.why: A cabeça is the head.

lab.why: Preciso de um médico means I need a doctor.

learn.b: Use menos ... do que for less than and tão ... quanto for as ... as. Ele é tão alto quanto ela means He is as tall as her. Ela é mais alta do que eu means She is taller than me.
Some words change completely: bom becomes melhor (better), ruim becomes pior (worse), grande becomes maior (bigger) and pequeno becomes menor (smaller). Never say mais bom.
Use o mais + adjective for the most: Ele é o mais alto da turma means He is the tallest in the class. Use o melhor or a melhor for the best: Ela é a melhor aluna.

qs.why: Melhor is already the comparative of bom.

qs.q: How do you say 'the tallest in the class'?
qs.why: O mais + adjective gives the superlative.

qs.q: Complete: Ele é tão alto ___ ela. (as tall as her)
qs.why: Tão ... quanto means as ... as.

qs.q: 'Menor' means 'bigger'.
qs.why: Menor means smaller; maior means bigger.

units.title: Right Now: Progressive and Recent Past

learn.b: Use estar + gerund (-ndo) for what is happening now. Eu estou comendo means I am eating. Falar becomes falando, comer becomes comendo and partir becomes partindo.
Estou estudando (I am studying), ele está trabalhando (he is working) and nós estamos jogando (we are playing). Add agora (now) if you like. Está chovendo means it is raining.
Use acabar de + infinitive for just: Acabei de comer means I just ate. Já means already: Já comi. Ainda não means not yet: Ainda não comi means I haven't eaten yet.

qs.q: How do you say 'I am eating'?
qs.why: Estar + gerund shows an action in progress.

qs.q: What does 'Ele está trabalhando' mean?
qs.why: Está + gerund is is working.

qs.q: What does 'Acabei de comer' mean?
qs.why: Acabar de means to have just done.

qs.q: What does 'ainda não' mean?
qs.why: Ainda não is not yet.

qs.q: 'Já comi' means 'I have not eaten yet'.
qs.why: Já comi means I already ate.

learn.b: Object pronouns replace a noun: me (me), te (you) and nos (us). In Brazil they usually go before the verb: Ele me viu means He saw me. Ela te ligou means She called you.
Use o for him or it and a for her or it: Eu o vejo (I see him) and Eu a conheço (I know her). The plurals are os and as. The pronoun matches the gender of the noun.
Me also means to me: Ela me deu um presente means She gave me a present. Eu te amo means I love you. Eu lhe disse means I told him or her.

qs.q: What does 'Ele me viu' mean?
qs.why: Me is the object, so he saw me.

qs.q: How do you say 'She called you'?
qs.why: Te goes before the verb.

qs.q: Which pronoun means 'her' as an object?
qs.why: A is her; o is him.

qs.q: Complete: Eu ___ amo. (I love you)
qs.why: Te means you.

qs.q: 'Nos' means 'us'.
qs.why: Nos is the object pronoun for us.

A aula is a class, a prova is a test, a matéria is a subject and o dever de casa is homework. Tenho uma prova amanhã means I have a test tomorrow.

learn.b: Russian nouns are masculine, feminine or neuter. Most masculine nouns end in a consonant, like стол (stol) table. Feminine nouns often end in -а or -я, like книга (kniga) book. Neuter nouns end in -о or -е, like окно (okno) window.

learn.b: Some letters look and sound like English: А (a), К (k), М (m), О (o), Т (t). Some look the same but sound different: В is v, Н is n, Р is r, С is s and У is oo. Try мама (mama) mom, кот (kot) cat and дом (dom) house.

Б (b), Г (g), Д (d), З (z), Л (l), П (p) and Ф (f) are easy. Special ones are Ж (zh like the s in measure), Ш (sh), Ч (ch), Щ (shch), Ц (ts), Х (kh), Я (ya), Ю (yu), Ё (yo), Э (e) and Ы (a hard i sound).
The soft sign ь makes no sound; it softens the letter before it. The hard sign ъ is rare. An unstressed О sounds like a, so молоко (moloko) sounds like malako. Russian has 33 letters.

Работать (rabotat) is to work, любить (lyubit) to love, знать (znat) to know and пить (pit) to drink. Я пью воду (Ya pyu vodu) means I drink water. Я не знаю (Ya ne znayu) means I don't know.

learn.b: Russian past verbs change by gender, not by person. Add -л (-l) for masculine, -ла (-la) for feminine and -ли (-li) for plural. A boy says я читал (ya chital) and a girl says я читала (ya chitala).
For we, you (plural) and they, use -ли: мы работали (my rabotali) means we worked. For the past of to be, use был (byl), была (byla), было (bylo) and были (byli).
Use вчера (vchera) for yesterday, сегодня (segodnya) for today, завтра (zavtra) for tomorrow and на прошлой неделе (na proshloy nedele) for last week.

Я предпочитаю (Ya predpochitayu) means I prefer. Потому что (potomu chto) means because. Use it to give a reason: Я люблю кино, потому что оно интересное.

learn.b: Use буду (budu) plus an infinitive for the future. Завтра я буду работать (Zavtra ya budu rabotat) means Tomorrow I will work. Other forms are будешь, будет, будем.
Many routine verbs are reflexive and end in -ся or -сь: я умываюсь (ya umyvayus) I wash up. Others are я встаю (ya vstayu) I get up and я ложусь спать (ya lozhus spat) I go to bed.
Use каждый день (kazhdy den) for every day, всегда (vsegda) for always and в следующем году (v sleduyushchem godu) for next year.

learn.b: Russian nouns change their endings (cases). A direct object takes the accusative. Feminine -а becomes -у: Я читаю книгу (Ya chitayu knigu) means I read a book. Lifeless masculine nouns stay the same: Я вижу дом. A male person adds -а: Я вижу брата (Ya vizhu brata).

Use в (v) for inside places and на (na) for open places and events, plus the prepositional case, usually ending in -е: в Москве (v Moskve), в школе (v shkole), на улице (na ulitse), на работе (na rabote) at work.
Use о (o) to say about: Я думаю о маме (Ya dumayu o mame) means I think about mom. Мы говорим о фильме means We talk about the film. A few words end in -у: в аэропорту (v aeroportu) at the airport.

learn.b: To say you do not have something, use нет (net) plus the genitive: У меня нет брата (U menya net brata) means I have no brother. Feminine -а becomes -ы or -и: У меня нет книги (U menya net knigi).

The genitive shows who owns something: книга брата (kniga brata) is the brother's book and дом мамы (dom mamy) is mom's house. It also follows из (iz) from and без (bez) without: кофе без сахара (kofe bez sakhara).

One uses the basic form: один стол. Two to four use the genitive singular: два стола (dva stola), три книги (tri knigi). Five and more use the genitive plural: пять столов (pyat stolov), пять книг (pyat knig).

learn.b: Идти (idti) is one direction, right now. Ходить (khodit) is a habit or a round trip. Я иду в школу (Ya idu v shkolu) means I am going to school now. Я хожу в школу каждый день (Ya khozhu v shkolu kazhdy den) means I go to school every day.

Ехать (yekhat) is going by vehicle now and ездить (yezdit) is a habit. Я еду в Москву на поезде (Ya yedu v Moskvu na poezde) means I am going to Moscow by train. Мы ездим на море каждое лето means We go to the sea every summer.

Ask Куда? (Kuda?) for where to: Куда ты идёшь? (Kuda ty idyosh?) means Where are you going? Use в + accusative for going to a place: в школу, в магазин, в Москву. Лететь (letet) is to fly: Я лечу в Рим.

learn.b: Голова (golova) is head, рука (ruka) hand or arm, нога (noga) leg or foot, спина (spina) back and живот (zhivot) stomach. Say У меня болит голова (U menya bolit golova) for I have a headache. For many things use болят: У меня болят ноги.

Врач (vrach) is a doctor, лекарство (lekarstvo) medicine and температура (temperatura) fever. Say Я болею (Ya boleyu) for I am ill, У меня температура for I have a fever and Мне нужен врач (Mne nuzhen vrach) for I need a doctor.

Many comparisons end in -ее: быстрее (bystreye) faster, интереснее (interesneye) more interesting. Чем (chem) means than. Irregular ones are лучше (luchshe) better, хуже (khuzhe) worse, больше (bolshe) more and меньше (menshe) less.

learn.b: Most Russian verbs come in pairs. The imperfective shows a process or habit: Я читал книгу (Ya chital knigu) means I was reading a book. The perfective shows a finished result: Я прочитал книгу (Ya prochital knigu) means I finished reading the book.

Делать and сделать (delat, sdelat) mean to do. Писать and написать (pisat, napisat) mean to write. Покупать and купить (pokupat, kupit) mean to buy. Говорить and сказать (govorit, skazat) mean to speak and to say. The first is imperfective and the second is perfective.

The imperfective future uses буду + infinitive: Я буду читать (Ya budu chitat) means I will be reading. The perfective future uses simple endings: Я куплю хлеб (Ya kuplyu khleb) means I will buy bread. Perfective verbs have no present tense.

learn.b: The dative shows who receives or needs something. Feminine -а becomes -е: Я даю книгу маме (Ya dayu knigu mame) means I give a book to mom. Мне нужно (Mne nuzhno) means I need. Age uses the dative: Мне пятнадцать лет (Mne pyatnadtsat let) means I am fifteen.

The instrumental shows with or by means of: с другом (s drugom) with a friend, с мамой (s mamoy) with mom. Я пишу ручкой (Ya pishu ruchkoy) means I write with a pen. Masculine ends in -ом and feminine in -ой. Он работает врачом means He works as a doctor.

Я хотел бы (Ya khotel by) means I would like, said by a man. A woman says Я хотела бы (Ya khotela by). Я хотел бы кофе means I would like a coffee. Хочу, чтобы ты пришёл (Khochu, chtoby ty prishyol) means I want you to come; чтобы is followed by the past form.
